gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.duc) Game Save (Europe)

format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header written by a converter ('Converted Savegame' / 'Savegame', ASCII 'shuny conv'), then 256 KiB raw for the 512 KiB flash (padded 262144 -> 524288 with 0xFF)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-ards.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step0.bin --chip 524288 --stem 'Pokemon - Pearl Version (USA) (Rev 5)' --out DIR: drops the Action Replay header; fits it to the 524288-byte chip (padded 262144 -> 524288 with 0xFF) and writes each core's file

melonds.detail: "A communication error has occurred" ("... you will be returned to wherever you last saved") instead of the CONTINUE panel, then a white screen; melonDS 0.9.3 does the same with its own Pearl save from this corpus, so it is the core (no BIOS or firmware here, FreeBIOS), not this save

note: Release: Diamond/Pearl layout, English (the description says French); Pearl from the version that caught the player's own Pokemon (origin game in the decrypted Pokemon data, OT matching the trainer); Europe from the section. The library's image of this game code is the Pokemon - Pearl Version (USA) (Rev 5) release; the save was run in it, since both releases share the game code.
